I have resolved the issue where proxy authentication resulted in HTTP 407 (Proxy Authentication Required).

### Cause
In requests 2.27.0, [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) in [requests/utils.py](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py) was changed to use `urllib3.util.parse_url` instead of `urllib.parse.urlparse`. Unlike `urlparse`, `urllib3.util.parse_url` stores user authentication separately in the `auth` attribute (`Url.auth`) rather than including it as part of `Url.netloc`. Because [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L986) reconstructed the URL using only `parsed.netloc`, any `auth` components (`user:password@`) were omitted when reconstructing the URL via `urlunparse`. Consequently, when [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///testbed/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) processed the proxy URL through `prepend_scheme_if_needed`, the credentials were lost, resulting in missing `Proxy-Authorization` headers and HTTP 407 responses.

### Solution
In [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L986), re-attach `auth` to `netloc` (`netloc = auth + '@' + (netloc or '')`) when `auth` is present before calling `urlunparse`.
